name: screenconnect-cleanup
title: ScreenConnect Cleanup
blurb: Windows technician tool that finds every ScreenConnect instance, shows its relay host, and removes the ones you choose (quarantined, never deleted).

name: remote-access-tool-blocker
title: Remote-Access Tool Blocker
blurb: Blocks AnyDesk, TeamViewer, ScreenConnect, RustDesk and about fifty other remote-access tools that tech-support scammers abuse, using Windows App Control signer rules, with an optional ESET web-filter list.

name: remote-diagnostics
title: Remote Diagnostics
blurb: One window to find out why a Windows PC crashes, freezes, won't print or won't wake: event logs, blue screens, print queues and startup items, zipped with a review list.

name: student-times
title: Student Times
blurb: Set the hours a Windows account can sign in with a click-and-drag weekly grid, with temporary unlocks, logout tasks and a push to every PC in the classroom.
